name: Technologia po ludzku

profiles.name: Public and persona workspace navigation
requirements: Named Base UI public mobile modal with focus containment, Escape and trigger return.
Workspace mobile navigation is an expanded inline menu, with Escape return.
Role selection is a simulation.

profiles.name: Task and submitted-record headers
requirements: One H1 with optional eyebrow, description and wrapping action.
Graphite header identifies the immutable submitted record.
Collage is restricted to discovery contexts.

profiles.name: Named groups within one form
requirements: Semantic section with a unique heading ID.
Field has an explicit label/control association; prefilled text is excluded from its name.
Groups are not a simulated stepper.
Preserve source, generated and approved text separately.

profiles.name: Submitted materials and CV
requirements: Base UI owns actual tabs and keyboard behavior.
One surface contains snapshots, notes and actions.
Only the CV panel has file controls and a matching local preview.
Custom CV snapshots keep complete text.

profiles.name: Recorded event history
requirements: Ordered actual events with machine-readable time.
Latest event has aria-current=step.
Candidate projection excludes employer notes.
Materials precede history on narrow screens.

profiles.name: Persistent feedback and recovery
requirements: Info, success and warning are separate tones with text.
Errors identify repair and focus the affected field.
Import/reset remain confirmed; failures preserve data.

MatchScore.meaning: Fixed scenario example; not hiring probability or an assessment.

OfflineMap.fallback: Complete links for all matching jobs.

boundaries: This package supplies anatomy and scoped styling, not React controllers.
Keep HashRouter, Zod, persona projections, local state and snapshots in the host.
Static record examples do not simulate functional tabs or recruiting actions.
